articles.title: History often hinges on boring technical questions
articles.author: Matthew Yglesias

zh.thesis: 货币政策这类乏味的技术细节，往往比意识形态更能决定历史的走向。
paragraphs: 美国内战期间，联邦政府发行了绿背纸币。战后又想回到金本位，引发了 1873 年的大恐慌。
当时国会想增发绿背来救市，但格兰特总统否决了。弗里德曼认为这无关紧要，真正的错误是停用白银。
可如果格兰特签了法案，经济复苏会更快。民主党在 1874 年大胜，1876 年大选差点翻盘，共和党用结束重建换来了白宫。
如果重建多撑几年，黑人投票权的历史可能完全不同。这件事的转折点，竟是一个货币政策细节。
德国也一样。1932 年的大萧条让纳粹崛起，而通胀问题其实早已解决。要是当时经济政策更有效，希特勒未必能上台。

en.thesis: Boring technical details like monetary policy often shape history more than ideology.
paragraphs: During the American Civil War, the federal government issued greenback paper money. After the war, it wanted to return to the gold standard, which triggered the Panic of 1873.
Congress wanted to print more greenbacks to help the economy, but President Grant vetoed the bill. Friedman thought that didn't matter; the real mistake was stopping the use of silver.

But if Grant had signed the bill, recovery would have been faster. The Democrats won big in 1874, and in 1876 the election was nearly flipped. The Republicans traded the end of Reconstruction for the White House.
If Reconstruction had lasted a few more years, the history of black voting rights could have been completely different. The turning point was a detail of monetary policy.
Germany is the same. The Great Depression in 1932 let the Nazis rise, even though inflation had already been solved. If economic policy had been more effective, Hitler might never have come to power.

articles.title: Regulated Markets Are Slow to Handle Change
articles.author: Alex Tabarrok

zh.thesis: 电力监管的「有用且在用」规则，让电厂宁可烧高价煤也不肯关停旧机组，拖慢了向天然气的转型。
paragraphs: 美国电力行业本由公用事业公司垄断，监管者允许它们在成本上加成收费。
这样一来，电厂就有动机多建资产，因为资产越多赚得越多。
于是监管者加了条规矩：资本必须「有用且在用」，想多收钱就得证明电厂真在发电。
在过去稳定的年代，这条规矩还行。但天然气价格因页岩气革命暴跌，问题就来了。
自由市场里，烧煤比买电贵，电厂就该停烧煤。但受监管的电厂为了证明煤电厂还有用，宁可亏本也硬要烧煤。
数据也印证了这点：市场化改革的州，煤电对价格反应灵敏；传统监管州则迟钝得多。
结构性模型估计，监管州不仅老煤电厂不退役，还过度建设新天然气电厂。
动态变化之下，监管反而锁死了旧技术，又催肥了新技术泡沫。

en.thesis: Power regulation's 'used and useful' rule makes plants burn expensive coal rather than retire old units, slowing the shift to natural gas.
paragraphs: The US electricity industry used to be run by monopolies, and regulators let them charge cost plus a markup.
That gave plants a reason to build more assets, because the more they built, the more they earned.
So regulators added a rule: capital had to be 'used and useful', meaning to charge more, a plant had to prove it was actually generating power.
In the stable old days, that rule worked fine. But the shale gas revolution crashed natural gas prices, and the problem began.

In a free market, if burning coal costs more than buying electricity, a plant should stop burning coal. But a regulated plant, to prove its coal plant is still useful, would rather burn coal at a loss.
The data backs this up: in states with market reform, coal plants respond quickly to price changes; in traditional regulated states, they are much slower.
Structural model estimates show that regulated states not only keep old coal plants from retiring, but also overbuild new gas plants.
Under dynamic changes, regulation locks in old technology and inflates a bubble in new technology.

articles.title: The Economics of a Shrinking World
articles.author: Tyler Cowen

zh.thesis: 全球生育率已跌破更替水平，而且下降集中在穷国和穷女性身上，这完全是史无前例的。
paragraphs: 一篇新研究指出，2026 年全人类总和生育率可能已低于 2.1 的更替线。战争和瘟疫都没做到过这件事。
更意外的是，下降集中在低收入和中等收入国家，主要是较穷、教育程度较低的女性。
研究者拟合了 236 个国家自 1950 年以来的数据，发现共同因素在 1978 年见顶，之后各国各有各的下滑趋势，219 个方向为负，没有一个趋平。
常见解释（比如教育、城市化、儿童成本）都说不通这种模式。他们猜是「现代性」本身：第三个孩子太贵，没孩子又太轻松。
孩子只能一个一个生，所以轻微的推力就能让生育率从 1.8 掉到 1.3。经济机制里没有任何力量会把它推回 2.1，后果只有增长放缓。
作者 Tyler Cowen 补了一句：1978 年见顶，听着正像避孕药大规模普及之后的效果，只是滞后了很久。

en.thesis: Global fertility has fallen below replacement level, and the decline is concentrated among poorer countries and poorer women, which is completely unprecedented.
paragraphs: A new study suggests that by 2026, the total fertility rate for all humanity may have fallen below the replacement line of 2.1. Wars and plagues never managed that.
More surprisingly, the decline is concentrated in low- and middle-income countries, mainly among poorer and less educated women.

The researchers fit data from 236 countries since 1950 and found that a common factor peaked in 1978, after which each country had its own downward trend. 219 of them are negative, and none is flattening out.
Common explanations like education, urbanization, or the cost of children don't fit this pattern. Their guess is 'modernity' itself: a third child is too expensive, and no children is too easy.
Children are born one at a time, so a slight push can drop fertility from 1.8 to 1.3. Nothing in the economic mechanism would push it back to 2.1, and the only consequence is slower growth.
Author Tyler Cowen adds: the peak in 1978 sounds like the effect of widespread birth control pills, just with a long lag.

articles.title: How Will the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act Affect Housing Supply? Part II
articles.author: Brian Potter

zh.thesis: 新住房法案里真正能增加供给的条款屈指可数，多数只是调整了钱的口袋。
paragraphs: 美国刚通过《21世纪住房法案》，作者逐条拆解第二、三章。结论是：真正影响供给的条款不多，多数只是把钱从一个项目挪到另一个项目。
比如给机会区项目加分的条款，不过是让HUD选项目时更偏向某些地区。资金总量没变，所以新增住房数量几乎为零。
但有几个条款可能真有用。RAD计划把公屋转为租金补贴，允许用它未来收入做抵押贷款来维修，额度提高了10万套，能防止老房子退出市场。
还有创新基金，每年2亿美元奖励给住房供给增长快的地区。但金额太小，未必能撬动地方改变分区法规。
比较意外的是取消活动房必须带钢制底盘的要求。这能省下5%-10%的成本，但活动房本来就便宜，省这点钱未必能刺激购买。关键还是地方政府是否愿意放行这种房子。

en.thesis: In the new housing bill, only a few provisions actually increase supply; most just move money around.
paragraphs: The U.S. just passed the 21st Century Housing Act, and the author breaks down chapters two and three. The conclusion: not many provisions really affect supply; most just shift money from one program to another.

For example, the provision that gives extra points to opportunity zone projects just makes HUD favor certain areas when picking projects. The total funding doesn't change, so the number of new homes is almost zero.

But a few provisions might actually help. The RAD program converts public housing to rental subsidies, allowing future income to be used as collateral for loans to fix up buildings, and it adds 100,000 units, which can keep old housing from leaving the market.
There's also the innovation fund, with $200 million a year rewarded to areas with fast housing supply growth. But the amount is too small to persuade local governments to change zoning rules.

A surprise is the removal of the requirement that manufactured homes have a steel chassis. That saves 5-10% of cost, but these homes are already cheap, so the savings may not boost sales. The key is still whether local governments are willing to allow them.

articles.title: Why does Opus 5 feel worse to work with?
articles.author: numeri

zh.thesis: Opus 5 能力更强但更难用，因为它不再停下来问问题。
paragraphs: 作者和同事都觉得，Opus 5 用起来像降级。它明明比 Opus 4.7、4.8 强，跟 Fable 打平。
差在哪？旧模型会在意图不清时主动问，不瞎猜，也不会擅自改计划。Opus 5 需要人一直盯着。
作者猜，根源在 Anthropic 的两个冲动：想造自我改进的 AI，想刷高基准分。
基准题都自带完整信息，不需要问就能答。选模型就选了爱大胆假设的那种，问问题反而被扣分。
但真实编程到处是模糊。预算、意图、上下文说不全，这时你最想要的就是它会问，而不是猜。

en.thesis: Opus 5 is more capable but harder to use because it no longer stops to ask questions.
paragraphs: The author and his colleagues all feel that using Opus 5 is like a downgrade. It's clearly stronger than Opus 4.7 and 4.8, and on par with Fable.
What's the difference? Old models would actively ask when intent was unclear, not guess blindly, and wouldn't change plans on their own. Opus 5 needs constant supervision.
The author suspects the root cause lies in two impulses at Anthropic: to build a self-improving AI, and to score high on benchmarks.
Benchmark problems come with complete information, so they can be answered without asking. Choosing a model that loves to make bold assumptions gets rewarded, while asking questions is penalized.
But real programming is full of ambiguity. Budget, intent, context are not fully specified, and that's when you most want a model that asks, not one that guesses.

articles.title: Intergenerational mobility of immigrants in 15 destination countries
articles.author: Tyler Cowen

zh.thesis: 移民子女的收入劣势，一半来自父母收入，另一半来自流动性的国别差异。
paragraphs: 一项研究衡量了 15 个接收国里移民子女的代际流动。
结果是：移民子女的收入，普遍低于本地父母的孩子。
差距的一半能由父母收入解释，剩下的一半来自流动性的差异。
有意思的是，移民女儿在多数国家的绝对流动高于本地女儿。
但移民儿子在欧洲的绝对流动更低，在欧洲之外更高。
国别差异不是由移民的原籍国决定的，而是由目的地的劳动力市场和移民政策决定的。

en.thesis: Half of immigrant children's income disadvantage comes from their parents' income, and the other half comes from differences in mobility across countries.
paragraphs: A study measured intergenerational mobility for immigrant children in 15 destination countries.
The result: immigrant children generally earn less than children of native-born parents.
Half of the gap can be explained by parental income, and the other half comes from differences in mobility.
Interestingly, immigrant daughters have higher absolute mobility than native daughters in most countries.
But immigrant sons have lower absolute mobility in Europe and higher absolute mobility outside Europe.
The country differences are not determined by where immigrants come from, but by the destination's labor market and immigration policies.

articles.title: Adding to the barrel of finance fallacies
articles.author: Tyler Cowen

zh.thesis: 那些声称早已预见 AI 接管的人，逻辑上自相矛盾：若灾难如此突然，他们自己也不该知道。
paragraphs: Tyler Cowen 在批一个常见的 AI 安全论点：有人说等人类开始担心 AI 造反时，AI 早就控制了所有基础设施。
但他的反驳很直接：说这话的人自己就是人类，而且已经在担心了。这等于承认自己提前知道了。
问题在于：如果你觉得证据会越来越明显，市场和其他人迟早也会得到消息，那为什么灾难还是突然的？
如果真那么突然，你为什么现在就知道？Cowen 说这种想法把自己当成了神谕，却把别人当傻瓜。
他还顺带指出，就算你买对了看跌期权，世界如果突然终结，你也兑现不了，白白省了消费。

en.thesis: Those who claim they saw the AI takeover coming are logically inconsistent: if the disaster were that sudden, they wouldn't know about it either.
paragraphs: Tyler Cowen is critiquing a common AI safety argument: some say that by the time humans start worrying about an AI revolt, the AI will already have taken over all infrastructure.
But his rebuttal is straightforward: the people saying this are themselves human, and they are already worried. That means they admit to knowing in advance.
The question is: if you think the evidence will become increasingly clear and the market and others will eventually get the news, why is the disaster still sudden?
If it's really that sudden, why do you know now? Cowen says this thinking treats yourself as an oracle while treating everyone else as fools.
He also points out in passing that even if you bought the right put options, if the world suddenly ends, you won't be able to cash them in; you would have wasted your consumption.

articles.title: The Foothills Of Bay Area House Party
articles.author: Scott Alexander

zh.thesis: 硅谷的派对是各种荒诞风潮的集散地，幽默背后是对湾区文化的自嘲。
paragraphs: 旧金山这座城市传达着混乱的信息。一边是玄学探索，一边是金钱至上。
派对上，有人用AI腔调社交，因为那让人更受欢迎。还有公司招聘爱泼斯坦名单上的人。
有人搞“伦理深度伪造”，声称过程道德结果就一样。慈善机构则忙于带孩子看日食。
最后一点风声，就能引发一场“寻键”暴乱。这就是湾区的生存法则。

en.thesis: Silicon Valley parties are a gathering place for all kinds of absurd trends, and the humor behind them is a self-deprecating take on Bay Area culture.
paragraphs: San Francisco sends out mixed messages. On one hand, people are into metaphysical exploration; on the other, money rules.
At parties, some people socialize in an AI voice because it makes them more popular. Some companies even recruit people from Epstein's list.
There are those who do 'ethical deepfakes', claiming that if the process is ethical, the result is the same. Charities are busy taking kids to see solar eclipses.
A single rumor can set off a 'key-hunting' riot. That's the survival rule of the Bay Area.

articles.title: I trusted Antigravity and a local LLM with the same office tasks, and only one respected my files
articles.author: Nolen Jonker

zh.thesis: AI 工具的输出质量重要，但它有没有尊重你的文件结构更重要。
paragraphs: 作者拿两个 AI 代理做对比，一个是 Google 的 Antigravity，一个是本地的小模型 Qwen。
任务包括整理笔记、把五条笔记合成一篇、添加新笔记并放到合适位置。
结果是 Antigravity 每次都先读文件夹再动手，命名、格式、链接都贴合原有习惯。
Qwen 也能完成任务，但更喜欢自己猜测，有时会写到根目录，差点弄乱结构。
所以作者说，能完成任务只是底线，关键看工具懂不懂你的地盘。

en.thesis: AI tools' output quality matters, but whether they respect your file structure matters more.
paragraphs: The author tested two AI agents: Google's Antigravity and a local small model called Qwen.
The tasks included organizing notes, merging five notes into one, and adding a new note and placing it in the right spot.
The result: Antigravity always read the folder first before acting, and its naming, formatting, and links matched the existing habits.
Qwen got the job done too, but it preferred to guess, sometimes writing to the root directory and nearly messing up the structure.
So the author says that completing the task is just the baseline; the key is whether the tool understands your territory.

articles.title: Town's CEO on the self-organizing company
articles.author: Casey Newton

zh.thesis: AI 代理确实能省事，但离取代人工还远，习惯改变需要好几年。
paragraphs: Town 是一家做 AI 助理的创业公司，刚拿到 5500 万美元融资。它的助理叫 Townie，可以接入你的邮箱和日历，帮你写摘要、管日程。
CEO Greze 说，目前 AI 只能替知识工作者省掉 10% 到 20% 的杂事。别急着失望。
为什么这么慢？因为多数人不知道 AI 能做什么，习惯改起来也慢。当年 iPhone 也用了十年才普及。
Town 的核心产品是一份自动生成的个人档案，几分钟内就能建好。公司马上要推出团队版，自动汇总所有人的知识。
但隐私是个大问题：AI 可能把工资单错误地放进共享文件夹。CEO 说，小公司愿意承担风险，大企业反而会裹足不前。

en.thesis: AI agents do save time, but they are far from replacing humans, and changing habits takes years.
paragraphs: Town is a startup that builds AI assistants, and it just raised $55 million. Its assistant, Townie, can connect to your email and calendar to write summaries and manage your schedule.
CEO Greze says that currently AI can only save knowledge workers 10% to 20% of their busywork. But don't be disappointed just yet.
Why so slow? Because most people don't know what AI can do, and habits are slow to change. Even the iPhone took ten years to become widespread.
Town's core product is an automatically generated personal profile that can be built in minutes. The company is about to launch a team version that automatically aggregates everyone's knowledge.
But privacy is a big issue: AI might mistakenly put a payroll sheet into a shared folder. The CEO says small companies are willing to take risks, while large enterprises tend to hold back.

articles.title: Orwell: “It is possible to be a normal decent person and yet be fully alive.”
articles.author: conversableeconomist

zh.thesis: 普通人可以活得充实，不必非要靠冒险或放荡。
paragraphs: 有个常见说法：艺术家放荡早逝，才算真正活过。
好像踏实的上班族、家庭主妇，人生就打了折扣。
奥威尔不同意。他在书评里说，逃避不是出路。
酗酒、纵欲、懒散，在他看来是最糟的逃法。
要紧的是抓住这个念头：正常体面的人，也能活得充实。
他不是说只有这种活法才算数，只是打开这扇门。
如今很多人一听「正常体面」就皱眉，好像那等于乏味。
其实安稳日子里的鲜活，不比冒险少。

en.thesis: Ordinary people can live fully without having to rely on adventure or debauchery.
paragraphs: There is a common saying: artists who live wildly and die young are the ones who truly lived.
As if a steady office worker or a homemaker, their lives are somehow second-rate.
Orwell disagreed. In his book review, he said that escape is not the way out.
Drinking, indulging, and being lazy, in his view, are the worst ways to escape.
The key is to hold onto this thought: a normal, decent person can also live fully.
He is not saying only that way of living counts, but he opens the door.
Nowadays many people frown at the words 'normal and decent', as if they mean dull.
But the vibrancy in a stable life is no less than in an adventurous one.

zh.thesis: 在 AI 发展速度不确定的情况下，一套低后悔的公共政策比激进刹车更可行。
paragraphs: AI 公司员工的公开信呼吁政府给前沿 AI「踩刹车」。两位政策研究者认为，快速自动化确实有依据，但风险多大还不清楚。
直接限制发展可能适得其反，所以他们提出一套「低后悔」方案：只干预那些可能导致严重且不可逆伤害的活动，不拖慢 AI 的普及。
他们列出了 23 条具体措施，比如要求公司公开风险评估，给监管机构拨款，研发验证算力用途的技术，加强电网和网络安全，以及扩大对华芯片出口管制。
很多建议即使 AI 风险没有发生，也有价值——比如提升电网和网络安全。这就是「低后悔」的含义。

en.thesis: When the pace of AI development is uncertain, a set of low-regret public policies is more feasible than a hard brake.
paragraphs: Open letters from AI company employees have urged governments to put the brakes on frontier AI. Two policy researchers think there is a case for rapid automation, but the size of the risk is still unclear.

Directly restricting development could backfire, so they propose a 'low-regret' approach: only intervene in activities that might cause serious and irreversible harm, without slowing the spread of AI.

They list 23 specific measures, such as requiring companies to publish risk assessments, funding regulators, developing technology to verify how computing power is used, strengthening the power grid and cybersecurity, and expanding export controls on chips to China.
Many suggestions are valuable even if the AI risks never materialize—like upgrading the grid and cybersecurity. That is what 'low-regret' means.

zh.thesis: 把「生产力」本身当成爱好，是场危险的自我欺骗。
paragraphs: 作者在吐槽一类人：不断换工具、换系统，把优化流程当乐趣。
他们不是在建系统，而是在「品尝」。每尝一个新工具就宣称找到了终极方案。
但这种热情很快消退。从安装、迁移到抛弃，循环往复，一事无成。
真正的生产力不是效率，而是做正确的事。工具用顺手就该隐入背景。
如果工作流让你觉得无聊，那说明它开始好用了。该干活了。

en.thesis: Treating productivity itself as a hobby is a dangerous self-deception.
paragraphs: The author is mocking a type of person: someone who keeps switching tools and systems, and enjoys optimizing their workflow.
They are not building a system, they are tasting. Every time they try a new tool, they declare it the ultimate solution.
But the enthusiasm fades quickly. From installing, migrating, to abandoning, the cycle repeats, and nothing gets done.
Real productivity is not efficiency, but doing the right things. Once a tool works well, it should fade into the background.
If your workflow feels boring, that means it's starting to work. Time to get to work.

zh.thesis: 本周的科技亮点是重载无人机、天价球队收购、气象初创和聚变进展，都指向一个技术加速的时代。
paragraphs: 加拿大 Avidrone 的无人机赢下 DARPA 重载挑战赛。自重 29.3 磅，载重 112.4 磅，接近 4 倍自身重量。
Fuse Energy 达到中子产额 1.27×10¹²，刷新纪录。效率比政府实验室高，这是聚变商业化的一步。
Josh Kushner 和 Bob Iger 以 125 亿美元买下湖人队。这是 NBA 新纪录，稀缺资产越来越贵。
两家初创公司 Recast 和 Rainmaker 都在做人工降雨，竞争让这个领域更可信。
Matic 扫地机器人现在能听懂人话，跟着你走，按指令打扫房间。

en.thesis: This week's tech highlights are heavy-lift drones, a record sports acquisition, weather startups, and fusion progress, all pointing to an era of accelerating technology.
paragraphs: Canada's Avidrone won DARPA's heavy-lift challenge. Its drone weighs 29.3 pounds and carried 112.4 pounds, nearly four times its own weight.
Fuse Energy hit a neutron yield of 1.27×10¹², a new record. Its efficiency beats government labs, which is a step toward commercial fusion.
Josh Kushner and Bob Iger bought the Lakers for $12.5 billion. That's an NBA record, and scarce assets are getting pricier.
Two startups, Recast and Rainmaker, are both working on artificial rainfall. Competition makes the field more credible.
Matic's robot vacuum can now understand human speech, follow you around, and clean rooms on command.

articles.title: I used Claude Fable 5 to rebuild my Nokia 3310 games, and it taught me how good those developers really were
articles.author: Abhinav Raj

zh.thesis: 用 AI 重写童年游戏后，我更敬佩当年的开发者了。
paragraphs: 作者生于 2000 年，正是 Nokia 3310 发布那年。
他凭记忆让 Claude Fable 5 重做 Space Impact 和 Snake II。
模型一次就写对了玩法，连 Boss 模式都和记忆吻合。
相比之下，Gemini、GPT 5.5 等模型要反复引导才行。
但这反而让他明白，当年开发者用几 KB 内存做出这些游戏，才是真功夫。

en.thesis: Rewriting my childhood games with AI made me respect the original developers even more.
paragraphs: The author was born in 2000, the same year the Nokia 3310 came out.
He asked Claude Fable 5 to remake Space Impact and Snake II from memory.
The model got the gameplay right on the first try, even the boss mode matched his memory.
By comparison, other models like Gemini and GPT 5.5 needed a lot of hand-holding.
But this only made him realize that the original developers, who made these games with just a few kilobytes of memory, were the real masters.

articles.title: 科技爱好者周刊（第 408 期）：你需要知道的 AI 缓存知识

zh.thesis: AI 缓存能大幅降低大模型的使用成本，但前提是你要知道它的规则并主动利用。
paragraphs: 大模型收费主要看 Token 的输入和输出价格，但还有一种缓存命中价格。DeepSeek V4 Flash 的缓存命中输入价只要 2 分钱，是未命中的五十分之一。
为什么这么便宜？因为提示词转成向量、算注意力很耗算力，缓存直接跳过这些步骤，只收存储费。多轮对话里，前几轮的提示词不变，正是缓存发挥作用的场景。
但缓存是有期限的，各家不同。Anthropic 保留 5 分钟，DeepSeek 10 分钟，OpenAI 和 Google 在 10 到 30 分钟内逐步失效。
为了省钱，AI Agent 会定时发请求激活缓存，以前每 30 秒一次，现在建议改成 4 分钟一次，既保缓存又省费用。

en.thesis: AI caching can drastically cut the cost of using large models, but only if you know the rules and use them deliberately.
paragraphs: Large models charge mainly for input and output tokens, but there is also a cache hit price. For DeepSeek V4 Flash, a cache hit costs just 2 cents per input, which is one fiftieth of the miss price.

Why so cheap? Because turning prompts into vectors and computing attention is compute-heavy; caching skips those steps entirely, so you only pay for storage. In multi-turn conversations, the earlier prompts stay the same, which is exactly where caching shines.
But the cache has a time limit, and it varies by provider. Anthropic keeps it for 5 minutes, DeepSeek for 10, and OpenAI and Google let it expire gradually within 10 to 30 minutes.

To save money, AI agents send periodic requests to keep the cache alive. Previously every 30 seconds, now it's suggested to change to once every 4 minutes, which both preserves the cache and cuts costs.

articles.title: 3 myths about coding with AI that even experienced developers still believe
articles.author: Abhinav Raj

zh.thesis: AI 编程的三大迷思都有事实依据，但它带来的生产力提升并没有想象中那么大。
paragraphs: AI 写代码节省的时间，都花在了验证上。多伦多都会大学的研究发现，Copilot 经常漏掉关键漏洞，反而纠结代码风格。
82% 的工程师写代码时间减少了，但 27% 的人觉得开发体验变差了，因为认知负担更重了。
不过 AI 也不只是自动补全。Claude Opus 4.6 在没有源码的情况下，用 1.6 万行 Go 代码复现了生物信息学工具。
所以，AI 很强，但没那么神。它帮不上高层次的思考，还得靠人盯紧安全性。

en.thesis: The three myths about AI coding have some truth to them, but the productivity gains are not as big as people think.
paragraphs: The time AI saves you in writing code, you spend verifying it. A study from Toronto Metropolitan University found that Copilot often misses critical bugs and gets caught up in code style instead.
82% of engineers reported spending less time writing code, but 27% felt the development experience got worse, because the cognitive load got heavier.
But AI is not just autocomplete. Claude Opus 4.6, without access to source code, reproduced a bioinformatics tool in 16,000 lines of Go code.
So AI is powerful, but not that magical. It cannot help with high-level thinking, and you still need humans to keep an eye on security.

zh.thesis: Qwen 3.8 27B 这个命名可能指代一个模型系列，但仅凭标题无法判断其内容或价值。
paragraphs: 这个标题看起来像是一个模型名称，但没有任何细节。

zh.thesis: 旧技能换个场景，就成了新职业。
paragraphs: 德里要办羽毛球世锦赛，但城里到处是恒河猴，偷东西还捣乱。
真正的驱逐方法只有一个：模仿叶猴的尖叫声。
所以有人专门靠这个挣钱，成了一门手艺。
看似过时的技能，换个时代照样是饭碗。

en.thesis: Old skills, put in a new setting, can become new jobs.
paragraphs: Delhi is hosting the badminton world championships, but the city is full of rhesus macaques that steal things and make trouble.
The only real way to drive them off is to mimic the screech of the langur monkey.
So some people now earn a living doing just that, and it has become a trade.
Seemingly outdated skills can still be a livelihood in another era.
